title: Bin reading
description: A single fill-level reading sent from a Bincast device to the cloud ingest endpoint. All field names are snake_case.

device_id.description: The clip-on device itself. Set in device/config.py and never changes.

bin_id.description: Which bin the device is currently attached to. Separate from device_id because the device is designed to move between bins.

timestamp.description: UTC time the reading was taken, ISO 8601. Time taken, not time sent -- a buffered reading keeps its original timestamp.

raw_distance_cm.description: Median distance from sensor to the top of the contents, in centimetres.

fill_percentage.description: Fill level derived from raw_distance_cm and the current calibration. 0 = empty, 100 = full. Clamped at both ends.

status.description: The device's own assessment. The agent may disagree and override it.

calibration.description: The empty and full reference points the device learned for this bin by observation. Replaces any configured bin height -- nothing here is entered by a human.

empty_cm.description: Distance observed when the bin is empty. Effectively the bin's usable depth, learned rather than configured.

full_cm.description: Distance at which the bin is treated as full.

confident.description: False while the device is still learning the range. Downstream must treat fill_percentage as provisional when this is false.

sample_count.description: How many readings the calibration is based on.

quality.description: Raw signal evidence for this reading. The agent uses this to reach its own confidence rather than being handed a number.

samples.description: Raw pings taken before median filtering.

spread_cm.description: Range between the highest and lowest raw sample. A large spread suggests an unstable surface or a bad reflection -- the main obstruction signal.

rejected.description: Raw samples discarded as out of range.

fill_rate_cm_per_hr.description: How fast the level has been rising since the previous reading. Lets the dashboard forecast pickup timing, and lets the agent flag physically implausible jumps.

connectivity_status.description: Link state at the time of sending. 'stale' means the device is reachable but has not reported on schedule.

buffered.description: True if this reading was held on the device during an outage and sent later.

firmware_version.description: Semantic version of the device code that produced this reading.
